plume.upside: RWA push: joined the DTCC tokenization working group ahead of its October 2026 service launch; new Asian exchange listings add buyers.
plume.cheap: Down 91% from its high with heavy supply still to unlock; market has not yet seen real asset volume on the chain.
plume.wrongIf: Daily trading falls back under about $20M or the DTCC tie-up yields no product by year end.
plume.vsScanner: Scanner score 89 is mostly a 1-day spike (+20%); I could not confirm the Bithumb listing, so I am less excited.

redstone-oracles.upside: New listings (Bitvavo, HTX, Crypto.com) and oracle demand from DeFi/RWA apps.
redstone-oracles.cheap: Oracle sector is dominated by Chainlink; 72% of supply still unlocking over 4 years.
redstone-oracles.wrongIf: Price loses the listing bounce and daily trading drops under $5M.
redstone-oracles.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner, but its listing news is unconfirmed by me.

skale.upside: Gas-free chain with ongoing ecosystem work; +13% week.
skale.cheap: 234x from its high; the old high is not a realistic target.

sonic-3.upside: Coinone (Korea) listing and a +34% week with $278M daily volume.
sonic-3.cheap: Rally already underway; the scanner itself saw no sign of life for 38 days.
sonic-3.vsScanner: Scanner is fine on volume but I distrust a quiet project chasing a spike.

space-and-time.upside: Data-for-AI/blockchain product; no dated catalyst found.
space-and-time.wrongIf: No product news by year end.

nervos-network.upside: Bitcoin-layer-2 story (RGB++, Fiber network) and a possible treasury-use governance change.
nervos-network.cheap: Volume spike of 43x came from a small India listing (WazirX); no big catalyst found.
nervos-network.wrongIf: Volume returns to normal within days with price giving back the +26% week.
nervos-network.vsScanner: Scanner overrates a thin listing spike.

vana.upside: Data ownership for AI training; no dated catalyst found.
vana.cheap: Only 26% released: unlock overhang explains the low price.
vana.wrongIf: Big unlock lands without matching demand.

starknet.upside: Staking and upgrade work continues; BigONE listing.
starknet.cheap: Already up 260% this month; sources I found disagree on price, and another monthly unlock (about 127M tokens) looks due 15 October.
starknet.wrongIf: Price gives back most of the month on the 15 October unlock.
starknet.vsScanner: Scanner flags it as late, and I agree.

hyperlane.upside: Cross-chain messaging for new chains; staking rewards.
hyperlane.cheap: Only 42% released, so unlock pressure; no news found.
hyperlane.wrongIf: Daily volume falls under $2M or unlocks start hitting price.

flow.upside: Established chain tied to sports/NFT apps; no dated catalyst.
flow.cheap: 1,187x from its high: a trading range, not a cheap coin.

aioz-network.upside: Decentralized storage/streaming with real use; no dated catalyst.
aioz-network.cheap: Volume is only 3% of value, so nobody is trading it.

mina-protocol.upside: ZK chain; no dated catalyst. Dropped 50% in a week, which I could not explain.
mina-protocol.cheap: A 50% weekly fall is a warning, not a bargain.
mina-protocol.wrongIf: The fall continues or volume dries up.
mina-protocol.vsScanner: Scanner treats a 50% drop as a screen pass; I do not.

sushi.upside: DEX with a shrinking following; no dated catalyst.
sushi.cheap: Market has moved to other DEXs.

nockchain.upside: Proof-of-work chain with an active team; 7.9x from its high.
nockchain.cheap: Very thin trading ($1M/day on $63M value) so price is easily pushed.

pancakeswap-token.upside: Large, real DEX with fee burns; no new catalyst found.
pancakeswap-token.cheap: No mispricing found: it is just far below a 2021 peak.
pancakeswap-token.wrongIf: Weekly decline continues, DEX volume share slips.

tezos.upside: Established chain; no dated catalyst found.

pendle.upside: Real yield-trading product with real use; sits only 3.4x from its high, the most realistic on this list.
pendle.cheap: Fell 11% this week with no specific reason found.
pendle.wrongIf: Daily volume drops under $15M or the weekly slide continues past -25%.
pendle.vsScanner: Agree with the scanner; nothing extra found.

unibase.upside: AI memory layer, newest of the big names; only 1.8x from its high.
unibase.cheap: Only 25% released, so heavy unlocks ahead.
unibase.wrongIf: A large unlock; price falls under last month's low.

ethereum-name-service.upside: Real product (names) with revenue; no dated catalyst.

vechain.upside: Enterprise partnerships; no dated catalyst found.

falcon-finance-ff.cheap: Only 33% released and thin trading ($8M on $380M).
falcon-finance-ff.vsScanner: Scanner ignores thin trading for the size.
